entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Eheh, it's just like I imagined... The view[n]from a boat is amazing!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Sorry for dragging you out on one of[n]these. I was just so curious about what[n]it'd be like!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm glad to hear it. And I'm happy[n]I got to do this with you!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It really is! The wind feels great, too.[n]It's so refreshing out here.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I could say the same thing. I'm just[n]happy to have you here with me.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, I actually have a favor to ask.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: When we have to leave... can I be the[n]one to row us back?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: After watching you row us all the way[n]here, I just got this urge to try it!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It'll be my first time rowing a boat![n]Oh, I'm so excited!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Today was so fun! Thank you for taking[n]me out!
